pages.text: The $(item)Winding Machine$() wraps wire from a $(item)spool$() around a workpiece, one turn per tick. It makes resistors and coils, winds wire onto spools, and is a step in several sequenced assemblies.$(br2)$(l)Setting it up$()

$(li)Drive it with a shaft on its $(item)side$(). Any speed works: it winds one turn per tick as long as it turns.$(li)$(item)Spool$(): right-click the machine with a spool to mount it (the old one comes back to you). Right-click with an empty hand to take the spool off.
$(li)$(item)Workpiece$(): right-click with any other item to put $(item)one$() in. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take it back.

$(l)Automation$()$(br)Funnels and deployers can insert both: spools go to the spool slot, everything else to the workpiece slot. Only a $(item)used-up, empty spool$() can be pulled out of the spool slot, and wire in the workpiece slot is never pulled out.
With goggles you see the mounted spool, its $(item)turns left$(), and the progress of the current job.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
